source.title: חוק הפיקוח על שירותים פיננסיים (קופות גמל), התשס"ה-2005, ss.1, 13, 39 (Wikisource mirror)

regulator.notes: Managing companies are under the Commissioner's supervision (s.39(א)); a kupat gemel lehashkaa is a provident fund (s.1, s.13(א)).

source.title: Provident Funds (Management Fees) Regulations 2012, reg. 2(א)(2) (Hebrew Wikisource; cross-read on Nevo)

deposit.notes: Maximum fee of a kupat gemel (as defined for reg. 2) on the payments transferred for each member, as a share of each deposit.

source.title: Provident Funds (Management Fees) Regulations 2012, reg. 2(א)(1) (Hebrew Wikisource; cross-read on Nevo)

balance.notes: Maximum management fee of a "קופת גמל" (kupat gemel lehashkaa among them), per year, of each member's accumulated balance. In force since 2014 (a transitional 1.1% applied to 31 Dec 2013, reg. 7). Excludes fund types with their own caps (hishtalmut, IRA, pension). Legacy accounts (pre-2008 contributions, non-insurance fund) may be charged up to NIS 6 a month instead (reg. 2(א)(2א)); that amount was not read.

source.title: הלשכה המרכזית לסטטיסטיקה – מחשבון הצמדה, מדד המחירים לצרכן כללי (120010): 70,000 ₪ from 1.7.2016 to 1.1.2026, "to_value":83641.09

amount.notes: NIS per person per calendar year, 2026, across all kupat gemel lehashkaa accounts: the law's NIS 70,000 (Amendment 15 s.3, section 22(א)) indexed by the CPI; the CBS linkage calculator returns 83,641.09 for 1.1.2026, shown rounded to the shekel (KGL-03, KGL-24). No regulator notice is required. Updated every 1 January.

source.title: תקנות מס הכנסה (כללים לאישור ולניהול קופות גמל), התשכ"ד-1964, p.16, reg. 41יא(א)

payout_business_days.notes: Rule 41יא(א) of the 1964 Income Tax Rules: a provident fund pays a withdrawal within 4 business days of the day the request reaches it; if that date falls in the month's first three business days it may defer to the 4th business day of the month. The law's timetable for every fund, not one company's (scope pass 2026-10-25). The CMA standard bylaw for kupat gemel lehashkaa repeats it (ss.12.1-12.2). Tax is withheld at payment (TXK-07).

source.title: Income Tax Ordinance, s.3(ה4)(3) (Wikisource PDF p.8): the charge applies to sums an individual "משך"

switch_is_tax_event.notes: A track switch or a transfer to another kupat gemel lehashkaa is not a withdrawal; a transfer out to a different wrapper is.

eligibility.text: anyone, at any age, paying for themselves; an account may be opened in another person's name, which is an irrevocable gift

protection.text: assets are held in trust, separately from the managing company's property, and cannot be attached; if the company fails, management moves to another company; the state does not guarantee the fund's value
